ui_bugs.issue: React warning: '<button> cannot appear as a descendant of <button>'. InfoDot renders a <button> element which is being placed inside a parent <button> in some headers (e.g., universe summary card buttons that contain the InfoDot). Causes hydration warnings in console. Replace inner <button> with <span role='button' tabIndex={0}> or restructure parent so InfoDot is sibling, not descendant.

issues: Watchlist column-header InfoDot tooltips show readable content on dark surface, but the tooltip container's computed text color rgb(82,82,91) over bg rgb(18,18,18) yields a contrast ratio ~3.3:1 — below WCAG AA 4.5:1 for normal text. Inner heading is brighter so the body copy specifically should be lightened for accessibility (e.g., text-zinc-300/400 instead of text-zinc-500).
